system.label: System

inter.description: Clear and even, made for screens.

atkinson.description: Letters that are hard to mistake for one another, for low vision.

openDyslexic.description: Weighted letters that some people with dyslexia find easier to read.

clean.label: Clean
clean.description: Name and photo above each run of messages.

compact.label: Compact
compact.description: Name and time on the line of every message, with less space between them.

shown.label: Show in the message
shown.description: Pictures and previews of links open as the message arrives.

collapsed.label: Collapse until clicked
collapsed.description: A line in their place opens them when you want them.

whereLeft.label: Start where I left off
whereLeft.description: The first message you have not read, under a line that marks it.

newest.label: Start at the newest message
newest.description: The latest message, with everything before it marked read.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.off: A stolen password alone is not enough to sign in as you.
twoFactor.required: This instance requires a second factor for admins
twoFactor.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app or add the setup key, then enter the code it shows. Nothing changes until you do — an enrolment you never finished cannot lock you out.
twoFactor.recovery: Save these somewhere safe. They are shown once, and each one works once — they are the way back in if you lose the phone.
